notes:
v1.2.1 — critical fixes on top of v1.2.0.

• Cross-worker dedup for cloud bots — apex_server runs uvicorn with --workers 2 and each worker had its own in-memory bot registry. Consecutive starts hit different workers and spawned duplicates. Now writes a PID file at /opt/apex_users/user_<id>/pids/<side>.pid so every worker sees what's already running. (Killed 6 dup processes that v1.2.0 had spawned.)

• Cloud resume on app startup now works for LONG / SHORT too. Previously gated on the local 'Run on Oracle' toggle, which the desktop sometimes lost between sessions while the cloud bot kept running. Resume now queries Oracle regardless of the local flag.

• Stale brackets no longer shown on the daybot OPEN BRACKETS chart. After a manual liquidation, daybot_state.json kept the bracket until the bot's next sync cycle and the chart rendered it as a frozen '+0.0%' diamond. Now filtered by symbol presence in the live positions list.

• Charts display in your local timezone. Alpaca returns UTC; the equity / portfolio / lifetime / drawdown / combined charts now convert to your wall-clock time on the way out, AND the non-market-hours rangebreaks shift with you so the gap-skipping still matches the actual US session.

• Recommended values shown next to every spin-box in the bot tab (min AI confidence, min positions to hold, min score, max brackets, ATR multipliers).
